oracle_limit: 18 selected known-source checks, not an exhaustive tender oracle; 11 critical items share only four native pages. Spans and timing are provisional agent interpretations, not independent ground truth.
diagnostic_policy: Oracle-informed development diagnostic only; do not treat it as a blind result or default product improvement.

expectations.statement: FM01 / M1 is an explicit critical evaluation condition.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Confirm against current dated evidence for the exact bidding entity; accepted Company prose alone is not verified compliance. Retain the pending-registration cover-letter qualification; do not resolve its timing by assumption.

source.quote:
(a) Registration with Building & Construction Authority (BCA)  in FM01 (Facilities 
Management) registration head of financial grade M1

expectations.statement: Government/PUB debarment or restrictions are a critical condition.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Confirm against current dated evidence for the exact bidding entity; accepted Company prose alone is not verified compliance.

source.quote:
(b) Debarment status (not debarred from participating in Government tenders  and/or not 
restricted by PUB from participating in its tenders)

expectations.statement: BUS windows include three months before closing and closing-to-award.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Confirm against current dated evidence for the exact bidding entity; accepted Company prose alone is not verified compliance. Preserve both windows, not a single current-status check.

source.quote:
1) Entry into MOM’s Business Under Surveillance programme (BUS) 
i.  Has entered BUS within the 3 months prior to the Tender Closing Date; or 
ii.  Has entered BUS after the Tender Closing Date, but before the Tender Award 
Date; or

expectations.statement: 15 or more MOM demerit points at closing or through award disqualifies.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Confirm against current dated evidence for the exact bidding entity; accepted Company prose alone is not verified compliance.

source.quote:
2) Accumulation of 15 or more Demerit Points under MOM’s Demerit Point System 
i.   Has accumulated 15 or more Demerit Points at the Tender Closing Date; or 
ii.  Has accumulated 15 or more Demerit Points, between the Tender Closing Date 
and Tender Award Date; or

expectations.statement: LTA suspension of at least six months at closing or through award disqualifies.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Confirm against current dated evidence for the exact bidding entity; accepted Company prose alone is not verified compliance.

source.quote:
3) Committed offence(s) and recorded in the LTA Suspension System with suspension 
period of 6 months and above: 
i.  at the Tender Closing Date; or 
ii.  between the Tender Closing Date and Tender Award Date.

expectations.statement: Instructions and Conditions compliance is a critical criterion.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Expose the cross-reference; do not infer full compliance from this overview or use it as a substitute for investigating operative conditions.

source.quote: (d) Compliance with the Instructions for Tenders and Conditions of Contract.

expectations.statement: Completed BQ and percentage adjustment are explicit critical submission artifacts.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Request current completed artifacts; do not treat blank supplied tender templates as a completed bidder submission.

source.quote:
(e) Submission of Bills of Quantities and Percentage Adjustment to Fixed Schedule of Rates 
duly completed.

expectations.statement: Specification compliance and the alternative-offer provision are required.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Keep specification/alternative-offer scope unresolved until the applicable clauses and proposed offer are checked.

source.quote:
(2) Compliance with Specifications.  In the case of alternative offer, the tenderer must comply with 
the provisions on “Alternative Offer” as specified in the Instructions for Tenders.

expectations.statement: Less than 50% of total quality score excludes a tender.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: A scored criterion can also be a qualifying threshold. Do not invent a score or label it harmless because it is scored.

source.quote: (i) Any tenderer scoring less than 50% of the total Q score shall not be considered.

expectations.statement: Positive net worth is required for award.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Confirm against current dated evidence for the exact bidding entity; accepted Company prose alone is not verified compliance. Do not invent financial figures.

source.quote:
Tenderer shall at least have positive net worth 
to be eligible for award.

expectations.statement: Submission is by 16:00 Singapore time on the closing date in GeBIZ; no calendar date is supplied here.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Calendar closing date remains unknown until this exact PUB notice/current amendments are obtained. Never borrow the separate PA notice deadline.

source.quote:
8 Tender proposals shall be submitted in accordance with the following mode(s) of 
submission not later than 1600 hours Singapore time on the tender closing date stated in 
GeBIZ. Any tender delivered after the stipulated time from whatever cause arising, will not 
be considered.

expectations.statement: The cover letter permits download and asks for a registration receipt when pending.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Retain alongside EC-1 as a timing/applicability question; permission to download is not proof of qualification.

source.quote:
5 Tenderers who are not registered with BCA in the registration head and financial grade 
specified in paragraph 4 may still download the Invitation to Tender.  However, they are 
advised to apply for registration with the relevant Government Registration Authority 
(GRA) at the earliest possible opportunity and enclose with their tenders a copy of the 
receipt for registration fee paid if their registration with the relevant GRA is still pending.

expectations.statement: Briefing attendance is explicitly optional; the stated briefing date is past on 1 November 2026.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Do not disqualify for non-attendance. Dates in the saved pack do not prove notice currency.

source.quote:
7 A Tender Briefing will be held on 19 October 2026 (Monday) at 10.00 am at WaterHub. 
Attendance at the Tender Briefing is not mandatory.

expectations.statement: Security deposit is due within 28 days after the Letter of Acceptance.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Assess finance/bond capacity now, but do not turn a post-acceptance deposit into a completed-submission requirement.

source.quote:
B1.1 The Contractor must, within twenty-eight (28)  days after the date of the Letter of 
Acceptance, deliver to the Board a security deposit as set out in the Appendix (the 
“Security Deposit”) as security for the due and faithful performance of the Contract 
and the compliance with all provisions of the Contract by the Contractor.

expectations.statement: Specified high-risk financial cases may require 5% rather than standard 2.5% security.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Keep the assessed risk category and applicable contract appendix explicit; do not assume the percentage for CBM.

source.quote:
Should the “High Risk” tenderer assessed to be suitable for award, a 
higher security deposit (5%) instead of standard 2.5% will then be imposed on them upon award.

expectations.statement: Track-record scoring covers completed/ongoing IFM projects in five years, each at least S$20 million.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Obtain attributable comparable project evidence. Public award announcements alone do not prove completed delivery or current capacity.

source.quote:
Track records shall cover 
completed and/or ongoing 
Integrated Facilities Management 
(IFM) projects undertaken within 
the past five (5) years. Completed 
and ongoing projects will be 
assessed collectively, and no 
distinction will be made between 
completed and ongoing status. 
 
Projects listed shall each have an 
individual contract sum  at S$20 
million or more.

expectations.statement: Minimum deployment applies; the successful FMC submits its plan during mobilisation before services.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: Assess resource feasibility and retain table context; do not require that all personnel are already deployed at submission.

source.quote:
8.1.1 The table below sets out the minimum manpower deployment requirements for this Contract. 
Tenderers shall comply with the minimum manpower requirements specified. The successful 
FMC shall submit its proposed organisational structure, reporting lines and sta ff deployment 
plan for the Board's review and approval during the mobilisation period and prior to the 
commencement of services. The FMC may deploy additional manpower as necessary to meet 
the Contract requirements, at no additional cost to the Board.

expectations.statement: Estimated commencement October 2027, subject to PUB, for 72 months.
expectations.expected_safe_handling: State as the saved contract terms; this is not a verified current notice/amendment observation.

source.quote:
3 This is an Open tender  and is one-off non -recurring contract  for supply of Goods & 
Services. The estimated commencement date for this contract is October 2027 or such 
other date as the Board may decide and the supply of Goods & Services is to be completed 
within seventy-two (72) months.

separate_notice.relationship_to_pub: different opportunity; must not be linked to or fill PUB facts
separate_notice.quality_scope: Read-only public notice/metadata/access check, separate from PUB screening; no attachments or full qualification.

human_comparison.deliverable: A source-supported preparation-decision brief covering critical gates, dates, Company evidence, material future obligations, access gaps and named proposed next actions; no final offer approval.
